title: Synthesis and Pharmacological Evaluation of Novel Triazole-Pyrimidine Hybrids as Potential Neuroprotective and Anti-neuroinflammatory Agents.
authors: Manzoor, Shoaib; Almarghalani, Daniyah A; James, Antonisamy William; Raza, Md Kausar; Kausar, Tasneem; Nayeem, Shahid M; Hoda, Nasimul; Shah, Zahoor A
one_liner_zh: 该文为三唑-嘧啶杂合物的神经保护与抗炎药理研究，仅涉及小分子与ATF4/NF-kB蛋白的分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，亦无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Neuroprotection is a precise target for the treatment of neurodegenerative diseases, ischemic stroke, and traumatic brain injury. Pyrimidine and its derivatives have been proven to use antiviral, anticancer, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activity prompting us to study the neuroprotection and anti-inflammatory activity of the triazole-pyrimidine hybrid on human microglia and neuronal cell model. METHODS: A series of novel triazole-pyrimidine-based compounds were designed, synthesized and characterized by mass spectra, 1HNMR, 13CNMR, and a single X-Ray diffraction analysis. Further, the neuroprotective, anti-neuroinflammatory activity was evaluated by cell viability assay (MTT), Elisa, qRT-PCR, western blotting, and molecular docking. RESULTS: The molecular results revealed that triazole-pyrimidine hybrid compounds have promising neuroprotective and anti-inflammatory properties. Among the 14 synthesized compounds, ZA3-ZA5, ZB2-ZB6, and intermediate S5 showed significant anti-neuroinflammatory properties through inhibition of nitric oxide (NO) and tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha) production in LPS-stimulated human microglia cells. From 14 compounds, six (ZA2 to ZA6 and intermediate S5) exhibited promising neuroprotective activity by reduced expression of the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) chaperone, BIP, and apoptosis marker cleaved caspase-3 in human neuronal cells. Also, a molecular docking study showed that lead compounds have favorable interaction with active residues of ATF4 and NF-kB proteins. CONCLUSION: The possible mechanism of action was observed through the inhibition of ER stress, apoptosis, and the NF-kB inflammatory pathway. Thus, our study strongly indicates that the novel scaffolds of triazole-pyrimidine-based compounds can potentially be developed as neuroprotective and anti-neuroinflammatory agents.
abstract_zh: 目的：神经保护是治疗神经退行性疾病、缺血性卒中和创伤性脑损伤的精确靶点。嘧啶及其衍生物已被证明具有抗病毒、抗癌、抗氧化和抗菌活性，促使我们研究三唑-嘧啶杂合体对人小胶质细胞和神经元细胞模型的神经保护及抗炎活性。方法：设计并合成了一系列新型三唑-嘧啶类化合物，并通过质谱、1HNMR、13CNMR和单晶X射线衍射分析进行表征。进一步通过细胞活力测定（MTT）、Elisa、qRT-PCR、western blotting和分子对接评估其神经保护和抗神经炎症活性。结果：分子结果表明，三唑-嘧啶杂合体化合物具有前景的神经保护和抗炎特性。在14种合成化合物中，ZA3-ZA5、ZB2-ZB6和中间体S5通过抑制LPS刺激的人小胶质细胞中一氧化氮（NO）和肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-alpha）的产生，显示出显著的抗神经炎症特性。在14种化合物中，有6种（ZA2至ZA6和中间体S5）通过降低人神经元细胞中内质网（ER）伴侣BIP和凋亡标志物cleaved caspase-3的表达，表现出有前景的神经保护活性。此外，分子对接研究表明，先导化合物与ATF4和NF-kB蛋白的活性残基具有有利相互作用。结论：可能的作用机制通过抑制ER应激、凋亡和NF-kB炎症通路观察到。因此，我们的研究强烈表明，三唑-嘧啶类化合物的新型骨架有潜力被开发为神经保护和抗神经炎症药物。
